spec: Seed distribution of the un-reweighted cross-design pair: both randomization layers varied (behavioral HousingMarketEngine seed and the balance-weighted 10k-of-75k covariate subsample seed) over seeds 0-49, the seed set of monte_carlo_simulation.py; legs A joint (primary) / B behavioral-only / C covariate-only, each x {recalibrated (III.C floor search re-run per seed), frozen (committed 43,882.8125 held fixed)}, plus leg D the calibration anchor's own seed dispersion (unscored); production scoring path and $764.7482532227002B benchmark untouched; full 3,380-node surfaces, grids not restricted; parity gates G0-G6 with leg-A seed-42 replaying 59.30299434493775 / 20.856293209339483 to 1e-9; ex-ante verdicts T1/T2/T3 on the leg-A recalibrated mean and S1/S1b/S2/S3 on its dispersion; the composition-reweighted quartet (76.3/12.6/70.6/36.0) and the 150.6% external-gate variant are NOT re-seeded and inherit this dispersion only as a disclosed proxy

monte_carlo_sibling.note: behavioral layer only, synthetic population, calibration never varied; different design, quoted for calibration of the S1 threshold only

legs.D_anchor: calibrate_mobility_scale re-searched at each behavioral seed; scales only, unscored

variants.recalibrated: III.C floor search per seed: 4-5% CPR floor at 8% market rate, zero velocity, static 7% friction, lo/hi 1,000/500,000, 30 iters
variants.frozen: committed production scale held fixed at every seed (the definition of frozen)

design.share_basis: fed.export_headline_metrics dollars_b share_explained_pct vs $764.7482532227002B — the basis of the quoted 59.3/20.9/76.3/12.6, NOT the shared accounting basis of the 13.6% ABM row
design.statistics: numpy.percentile linear interpolation; SD ddof=1; 95% CI of the mean at z=1.959963984540054

G0a_committed_quotes.msg: cross_design_results.json reproduces the quoted committed values and the VII.D bands this run's thresholds are keyed to

G0b_liveness_pins_intact.msg: cross_design_reweight_results.json still carries the values the round-21 liveness gate pins (59.30299434493775 / 12.561542534955805); this run never writes that file

G0c_production_constants.msg: constants + 'run-2026-07-05-berger' manifest tag + frozen scale + pinned medians 83,730/403,200

G1_builder_equivalence.msg: seeded builder at seed 42 bit-equals cross_design_test._build_engine on all 8 population arrays

G2a_freddie_search_vs_library.msg: seeded freddie floor search == library search at seed 42: got 36085.9375 want 36085.9375 (|d|=0.000e+00 <= 0e+00)

G2c_synthetic_search_vs_library.msg: seeded synthetic search == abm.calibrate_mobility_scale at seed 42: got 43882.8125 want 43882.8125 (|d|=0.000e+00 <= 0e+00)

G3b_benchmark.msg: benchmark reproduction (upstream FRED/SOMA revision guard): got 764.7482532227002 want 764.7482532227002 (|d|=0.000e+00 <= 5e-02)

G4_leg_identity_at_seed42.msg: legs B and C at seed 42 recompute the parity cell exactly (scale, trapped, share all delta 0.0)

G6_floor_retention.msg: recalibrated floor-band flagged fraction 0.0% <= 20% (flagged seeds reported, retained in the primary distribution; frozen cells not gated by construction)

G0d_no_overwrite.msg: committed cross-design surfaces and artifacts byte-identical after the run

tex_line72_test.claim: the operative uncertainty is calibration, not seed noise (single-choice swings span 20.9--59.3%)

verdict.text: leg-A recalibrated 50-seed mean >= 50% -> the undercut verdict survives seed averaging; VII.D's reading stands but the 50-seed mean and band must be quoted beside 59.3% wherever it appears.

thresholds.T1: leg-A recalibrated 50-seed mean >= 50% -> the undercut verdict survives seed averaging; VII.D's reading stands but the 50-seed mean and band must be quoted beside 59.3% wherever it appears.
thresholds.T2: 35% <= mean < 50% -> the verdict becomes AMBIGUOUS on the paper's own pre-committed partition; VII.D must say so, the abstract's 59.3% must carry the mean and band, and 'undercuts' is withdrawn.
thresholds.T3: mean < 35% -> the undercut was a seed artifact; VII.D reverts to corroborating the paradigm reading and every site quoting 59.3% requalifies.
thresholds.S1: tex line 72 ('the operative uncertainty is calibration, not seed noise') is FALSE if the leg-A recalibrated 95% seed band width >= 19.223350567799pp (= 50% of the committed 38.446701135598pp calibration swing); named SD equivalent >= 4.904006073436pp.
thresholds.S1b: if the band width >= 7.689340227120pp (20% of the swing; SD equivalent 1.961602429374pp) the sentence must carry the cross-design seed band explicitly and '20.9--59.3%' must be replaced by seed_aware_calibration_swing_pp.
thresholds.S2: if fewer than 90% of leg-A recalibrated seeds carry the same cross_design_test.classify label as the mean, the verdict is seed-fragile and the band-crossing shares must be reported.
thresholds.S3: if 59.30299434493775 lies outside [p25, p75] of the leg-A recalibrated distribution, the manuscript must disclose that 59.3% is an atypical draw and lead with the mean and band.
